name: Animus
source:
The Demon Lord who conquered her world. She's very haughty and tends to recklessly dive right into anything that seems interesting. After discovering a door to a new world to conquer, she and her friend Lilim were captured and sold into slavery in said world.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ385224.html/]DLsite[/url]]
